implementation: Optional process-local BaseWait hook on WriteSession, installed only by explicit NativeWrites for registered workers. Provider API, durable save records, journal user_version4 and canonical/wire/event encodings unchanged. Hook survives adoption; explicit Saved resume attaches it to the new worker. Weak worker ownership avoids cycles.

Missing native data read retries use captured SaveIntent event/entity/workspace/base, exact native pin identity, checkout branch/generation and stable private file operation. Scoped secondary zero-wait SQL validates current grant/generation/root/authorization before registration, on each poll and after verifying arrival. Same-byte regrant is stale. Global64 wait slots are shared with descriptor readers; callback adapter slots reserved before same-file gate wait; context deadline/cancel/worker stop/fence checked throughout.

Missing structural builder paths carry a process-local one-byte base position. Rebuild returns/releases its three buffer permits and journal guards before that wait, then revalidates Saved and retries changed paths. Manifest demand uses the reserved structural class and excludes byte candidates; partial reads subsequently request only their required byte range. Full-covered old data is not hydrated. Verified arrivals reenter the original provider/builder checks. Partial-data recovery called inside rebuild still holds builder permits; that requirement remains incomplete.

Want snapshot/grant now cooperatively wait outside Engine/lease-state/object gates using the existing write-admission helper and one two-second deadline. Caller cancellation is checked while waiting; existing locked claim/grant revalidation and post-grant rollback remain. Other authority operations keep immediate admission. No speculative stream credit/observer changes.

Five new transport parents (nine scenario samples), one callback-capacity parent, one object-class parent and one two-phase actual-want unit are new ordinary cases. Other selected suites rerun for regressions. Three explicit isolated real-kernel parents cover new authenticated partial COW fsync/reopen, existing authenticated readonly range and existing native write/truncate/fsync/reopen.
development: First native full-overwrite diagnostic failed to observe demand: std::error::Error chain traversal cannot extract an anyhow context payload. Use anyhow downcast_ref for RebuildRange; all four initial parents then passed. A test initially tried a crate-private accessor; changed to the existing public Staged::Cow variant, without broadening production API.

First frozen attempt cffe482c0337b4f749c0a79a328f9e07caedcea414c34dd6fc30192ed808909a passed Windows13targets, three real kernel parents and13 direct images, but Linux content_transport failed native_capacity_return_between_refusal_and_pending_snapshot_keeps_round_authority with49 passes/1failure. Archive cow-base-attempt-cffe-before-credit-trace.zip SHA256 ae046f36b6b47838e5de797a100d8babcbdffe89f890090d16162903e1dbac26 retains380 exact inputs and raw outputs. Thirty isolated diagnostic repetitions then passed, but traced full transport failed native_pending_legacy_writes_continue_the_same_download_round with local_error WORKER_BUSY object effect commit in progress /reason failed after3932160 bytes, then262144 bytes in another round. This proves want readiness failure, not a new credit-observer fix. Diagnostic source/log archive cow-base-credit-diagnostic-snapshot.zip SHA256 d31c28c8ee953483ab3f8653120fcc6c959e83a1aaa61a8116515318d10231ad retained, original380inputs exactly restored before want fix.

First want-fix diagnostic transport run passed both round regressions but failed grant/shutdown retirement observation because the helper returned a generic worker cancellation before invoking the caller stop check. Invoke the caller-specific check first on worker stop/cancel, retaining its exact stop outcome and existing observation. No test assertion changed.
Early mutable-source builds/runs and diagnostic repetitions are not final-source qualification or extra unique passes. No Rust assertion, timing target or release gate relaxed.
not_qualified: The interim native coordinator can fetch required base bytes/pages during fsync. This does not fulfill the original no-peer fsync contract: hydration must move before mutation acknowledgement and fsync must become local-only. Partial-data recovery inside rebuild also still holds its buffer permits across remote waiting. Mechanism evidence does not close either requirement; no target is reinterpreted as merely avoiding replication acknowledgement. This preflight/local-fsync work is the next priority.

COW structural-demand admission after dispatcher idle/saturation is not measured here. The existing structural idle backoff can reach640ms; the original250ms foreground-admission release gate remains open and is not waived.

Generic-provider mounted COW canonical rebuilding, legacy whole-base conversion hydration, and serving missing reused chunks of a newly published root before peers learn its new authorized reference are not newly qualified. No bare-hash fallback or remote authorization bypass.

Native namespace create/delete/rename/atomic replacement/open-handle identity, long-lived writer metadata/time rebasing, autonomous startup/conflict retry and complete production lifecycle/status/poison/accept-error/shutdown remain open.

Automatic close/metadata batching, private-reader independence during journal FULL fsync, complete root/retention/GC/retirement and sustained physical storage progress, aggregate queue/byte/SQL/CPU/disk/RSS fairness/shutdown/30min soak, WP6.5 build/cache/change journal, WP6.6 negotiation/activation/migration/downgrade/old-executable/handoff and every original release gate remain required. No production activation, user mount, migration or live CAS deletion.

Prior CCR16 Windows same-family sample observed one live lease nonce and two overall download invocations; that retained limitation is not erased by this stage. No stronger zero-redundant-round/byte claim.
